findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_if_it_sticks" stacks urgency/override words (never, attention). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_if_it_sticks · Public sink: check_if_it_sticks, make_it_stick · Destructive: check_if_it_sticks, make_it_stick.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_if_it_sticks · Public sink: check_if_it_sticks, make_it_stick · Destructive: check_if_it_sticks, make_it_stick

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
